title: Pass on the doctor's instructions

scenario.en: You went with your uncle to the doctor. He did not understand the English instructions.
scenario.ar: رحت مع عمك للدكتورة. هو مافهمش التعليمات بالإنجليزي.

source: The doctor said: 'Take this medicine twice a day, after food. Drink water often and sleep well. Don't work hard for three days. If the pain continues, come back quickly.'

task.en: Tell your uncle exactly what he has to do.
task.ar: قول لعمك بالظبط لازم يعمل إيه.

key_points.en: Take the medicine twice a day, after food.
key_points.ar: ياخد الدوا مرتين في اليوم بعد الأكل.

key_points.en: Drink water often and sleep well.
Don't work hard for three days.
key_points.ar: مايتعبش نفسه في الشغل تلات أيام.

key_points.en: If the pain continues, come back quickly.

model_answer.en: You have to take the medicine twice a day, after food. Drink water often and sleep well. Don't work hard for three days, and if the pain continues, come back quickly.
model_answer.ar: لازم تاخد الدوا مرتين في اليوم بعد الأكل، وتشرب مياه كتير وتنام كويس. وماتتعبش نفسك تلات أيام، ولو الألم كمّل ارجع بسرعة.
